The bug was caused by [`outputLink`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/gemini_t6t2_r2/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L16-L53) in [Tokenizer.ts](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/gemini_t6t2_r2/work/src/Tokenizer.ts) unconditionally setting `lexer.state.inLink = false` after tokenizing the inner text of a link or image. When an image was nested inside a link, tokenizing the image's alt text via `outputLink` reset `lexer.state.inLink` to `false` while the outer link's text was still being scanned, allowing subsequent GFM bare URLs/emails to be tokenized as links by [`_Tokenizer.url`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/gemini_t6t2_r2/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L1028-L1064).

### Fix
Saved the previous `lexer.state.inLink` value (`outerInLink`) before setting `lexer.state.inLink = true` in [`outputLink`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/gemini_t6t2_r2/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L22-L30) and restored it (`lexer.state.inLink = outerInLink`) after `lexer.inlineTokens(text)` completes.
